name: Mupsi Shacklefridd
summary: Mupsi Shacklefridd is a goblin resident stationed just outside the port town of Ratchet in the Barrens. She serves as a local contact for travelers looking to smooth over troubled relations with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

sections.title: On the Outskirts of Ratchet
sections.body: Mupsi Shacklefridd operates just outside Ratchet along the dusty coastal roads of the Barrens. Life near the port town is always busy, with Steamwheedle guards patrolling the perimeter and merchants coming and going. For those who find themselves in poor standing with the goblins, Mupsi provides a path to reconciliation—provided travelers are willing to offer the supplies and labor the cartel demands.

faq.answer: She is a goblin stationed just outside the settlement of Ratchet in the Barrens who assists travelers seeking to restore their standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel.
Mupsi is located right outside Ratchet in the Barrens, close enough to the main settlement that wandering port guards and patrols occasionally cross her path.

faq.q: Why would someone talk to Mupsi Shacklefridd?
faq.answer: Travelers who have angered the Steamwheedle Cartel—often through run-ins with goblins or siding with pirates—can work with Mupsi through supply donations to repair their reputation.
